page.notes: Italic type is judged from the scan and may be partly wrong in the 17. paragraph and the Drusius sentence. Uncertain readings: "Jaddi" (the printed name may be Iaddi or Jaddua; the letter looks like f/s), "Esrafastæ" (the printed name is hard to read), "jactam" (the printed word is ligatured and could be read differently), "11" for the book/chapter number (printed as an old form, read as 11). "Socerū" uses a macron over u as printed. The short strokes at the right ends of some lines are printing marks, not text, and are not transcribed. The catchword "erno" is at the foot right and matches "hodi-" at the line end.
